surface_value: Bendeka readily forms bonds with other electron-rich molecules, which result in interstrand DNA crosslinks and very strong (covalent) bonds. Because cancer cells divide more rapidly than normal cells, they are more affected by this bonding and the death rate of cancerous cells is greater than the death rate of normal cells.
